messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — getting multiple customer escalations: hosted inference returning 502/504 and timeouts after the 23:12 deploy. Customers reporting partial success then sudden gateway failures. Sharing a sample curl and one customer error:
maria_cs: customer repro (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-ai.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd/llama-3-13b","input":"hello"}' -v
```
maria_cs: response snippet from the customer:
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\ncontent-type: application/json\n{ "error": "upstream read timeout" }
```
raj_sre: Thanks — pinging SRE oncall. Any deploy id or flag flips in that window? :warning:
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-17T23:12:17Z by devon_eng -> rollout start: canary=test-canary-3, 10% traffic to canary.
devon_eng: we toggled `enable_new_batcher` and rolled out canary variant that includes a batching optimizer and a route-tag change for some routes. I only flipped to 10%.
raj_sre: Looking at telemetry — 5xx spike maps almost exactly to canary nodes (tag=canary-v3). Latency on initial token higher, then requests time out waiting for backend kernels. Could be incompatible kernel selection under the new batcher.
maria_cs: FYI customers reporting billing hits too because they retried clients; second customer asked for emergency credit hold. Can we throttle or route them to stable? :sob:
devon_eng: I am going to pause the rollout and scale canary to 0% immediately. On it.
raj_sre: Two quick mitigations:
- Abort rollout (devon doing)
- Route traffic for affected orgs to `stable` with an override: `route=stable` (we can patch routing via console)
raj_sre: Running `kubectl get pods -l release=canary-v3 -o wide` shows several pods crashlooping with logs showing `KVCache: incompatible layout` and long GC pauses. That aligns with kernel mismatch.
maria_cs: I've told the three affected customers we'll route them to stable and open credits case. Support ticket IDs: CS-8791, CS-8793, CS-8796.
devon_eng: rollback command executed: `./deploy rollback --release canary-v3 --to stable` — canary pods being drained. Will watch.
oncall-bot: alert suppressed for group:incidents — manual mitigation in progress. :thumbsup:
raj_sre: After rollback telemetry looks better — 5xx rate dropping back to baseline. We'll keep canary at 0% and create a revert branch. Next steps:
- devon: create hotfix that removes the batcher flag + ensure kernel compatibility checks before rollout
- eng-runtime: add pre-rollout regression smoke that runs end-to-end with real model kernels
- SRE: add alert rule that ties 5xx increases to canary tag so we can auto-cut traffic faster
devon_eng: Agreed. I'll open PR with revert and add an integration check. Sorry for the noise — will follow up with postmortem.
maria_cs: Thanks all. I'll update customers and confirm credits. Posting final note to CS triage channel. :white_check_mark:
